messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PDR-7821 triggered: HIGH 5xx error rate detected on service=redwood-inference-gateway-prod (route=/v1/generate) across regions eu-west1, us-west1. Threshold breached: 5xx_rate > 2% for 2m. Pager created: https://pagerduty.example/PDR-7821

sara (oncall): acked PDR-7821 :wave: I’m on it. First check: recent deploys?

jon: saw a spike in error-rate graphs, looks correlated with a rollout ~20m ago to inference-runtime v2.3.2.

raj: copying logs from the edge gateway (snip):
```
E 2026-03-14T15:01:22Z inference-gateway request_id=abcd1234 status=502 model_proxy=timeout backend=grpc timeout_ms=12000
E 2026-03-14T15:02:05Z inference-gateway request_id=abcf5678 status=503 model_proxy=connection_refused backend=vm-34
```

leah: @sara, if it’s the runtime rollout we should consider routing traffic to the fallback model variant and scale up dedicated pool.

sara (oncall): raj, can you run quick health check on model backends? paste curl or k8s commands.

raj: running curl against health endpoint: `curl -sS https://runtime-eu-west1.internal/healthz` -> returns 500 intermittently. Running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o wide` shows several `CrashLoopBackOff` and `OOMKilled` in eu-west1.

mike: I’m seeing memory pressure on the runtime nodes — GC spikes followed by OOM. Might be a bad quantization path in v2.3.2.

ops-runbooks: Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/inference-runtime-5xx. Short checklist: 1) Roll back rollout 2) Drain nodes 3) Route to fallback model 4) Notify CS if >10% traffic impacted.

sara (oncall): ok executing rollback canary -> `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --namespace=inference --to-revision=7`

jon: started rollback in eu-west1 canary subset. Monitoring logs.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PDR-7821 acknowledged by sara (oncall). Escalation suppressed.

raj: after rollback, error rate down from 3.8% -> 0.6% in eu-west1 within 90s. us-west1 still showing elevated but likely secondary.

leah: can we route prod traffic for /v1/generate to dedicated pool in us-west1 until we confirm stability? Suggest using routing policy: `route: inference-gateway -> dedicated-pool-1` for 15m.

sara (oncall): applied temporary routing override to direct 30% traffic to dedicated pool and reduced concurrency limit on gateway to 50.

mike: watching infra metrics — instance memory usage dropping to baseline, no new OOMs. 5xx rate aggregate back under threshold.

jon: reaching out to CS: minimal customer impact noted, internal metrics show retries handled by client backoff. No major SLA breach expected.

leah: creating incident ticket in tracker: INC-2026-0314-7821 with summary and mitigation steps.

sara (oncall): good work team. Leaving a note to schedule a postmortem tomorrow — assign to runtime eng + infra. Also add trigger tests for quantization path.

pagerduty: PDR-7821 resolved by sara (oncall). Duration: ~9m.

mike: follow-up action items in the ticket: 1) revert problematic quantization commit 2) add memory headroom checks in rollout pipeline 3) add synthetic fuzz test for runtime v2.3.x.

sara (oncall): signing off from the thread. tagging @leah for postmortem lead. :white_check_mark:

leah: taking postmortem. Will coordinate with runtime and QA. Thanks all for quick response. :coffee:
